Interface BeanResolutionTracerProvider

All Superinterfaces:
Ordered
public interface BeanResolutionTracerProvider extends Ordered
Creates a BeanResolutionTracer for a context, discovered with ServiceLoader from META-INF/services/io.micronaut.context.BeanResolutionTracerProvider.

Every provider on the classpath is instantiated each time a context starts, before any bean is created, to be asked whether its tracer is active, so its constructor must be cheap and free of side effects. The tracer itself is only created when it is active. By default it is active only if discovery was enabled with ApplicationContextBuilder.beanResolutionTracerDiscovery(boolean), the system property micronaut.inject.trace.tracers or the environment variable MICRONAUT_INJECT_TRACE_TRACERS, so that a library on the classpath does not trace an application by accident.

The tracers of the providers receive their callbacks in the order of the providers, the end of a creation or an injection in the reverse order. The order of providers with the same order is unspecified.

Since:
5.3.0

  • Method Details

    • isEnabled

      default boolean isEnabled(BeanResolutionTracerProvider.Activation activation)
      Decides whether the tracer is active for a context. Invoked each time the context starts.

      A tracer meant for development only can activate itself for the matching environments, for example with activation.isDiscoveryEnabled() || activation.getEnvironmentNames().contains(Environment.DEVELOPMENT).

      Parameters:
      activation - What the activation can be based on
      Returns:
      Whether the tracer is active, by default whether discovery was enabled
